title: Re: World of Utilities
description: A mod that adds many utility recipes and textures to the RE: World of Tech modpack
body:
### A mod that adds useful Recipe and texture changes for the Re: World of Tech modpack
This mod was made to create better integration between the mods of the modpack

Includes recipes that combine items from:
- Oritech
- Refined Storage 
- Refined Storage Quartz Arsenal
- Energized Power
- Every Mining Dimension
- Builder's Void
